turn.text:
Per **msa-2019.pdf, p. 4** (Section 4.2, "Term and Termination"):

> "4.2 Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience on ninety (90) days' written notice to the other party."

So the MSA allows either party to terminate for convenience simply by giving 90 days' written notice to the other party (cite: d2#105–#106, msa-2019.pdf p.4).
